name: Noctara Human Registry
description: Verify whether a person is present and continuous via a consented, person-owned append-only behavioral record. Returns four claims (is_human, is_continuous, has_deviated, stands_behind) with provenance. A zero-auth fixture demo is at GET /api/v1/registry-demo so an agent can see the exact response shape without a key. Real checks require a bearer license key AND the person's recorded consent to the calling organization: no grant, no claims. This is a proof-of-human presence signal, NOT a consumer report; it must never be used for credit, employment or hiring, housing, or insurance eligibility, or for background checks or risk scoring (FCRA-prohibited uses). Revocation stops answers instantly.
